runs.deviceModel: Essential PH-1 client ↔ C10 tablet client, through P30 owner
runs.batteryState: usb-charging; drain estimated via batterystats with charging masked
runs.networkType: no internet; Wi-Fi Direct group, relay↔relay through the owner
runs.notes: RTT 14 ms idle (130 ms under load); throughput tablet→PH-1 2 MB burst; reconnect = relink after the client app restart (v1.0.104, run epoch fix); battery = PH-1 Bluetooth 78.7 mAh/20 min on 3040 mAh with LOW_LATENCY BLE presence (fixed in v1.0.105: BALANCED, no scan in a group — P30 then measured 0.3 mAh Bluetooth/20 min); forwardingBytes = mesh forwarding counters PH-1 + tablet.
No SIM in any test phone: the "keep cellular while in a group" check could not be run.
None of the phones reports android.hardware.wifi.aware; presence uses BLE + Wi-Fi DNS-SD + P2P peer scans instead.
By design: Android 7–9 can neither create nor join a group with app-chosen credentials, so it sits out offline Wi-Fi Direct (verified: no group, no prompt) and links over a shared LAN instead.

runs.batteryState: usb-charging; drain estimated via batterystats with charging masked
runs.networkType: same home Wi-Fi LAN, no internet (hub unreachable); found via NSD
runs.notes: Linked 8 s after launch, host↔host 192.168.10.x. Idle RTT 11–17 ms seen from the Honor, 64–84 ms from the P30 (Wi-Fi power save), median ~40 ms. Throughput 2 MB burst P30→Honor 55.2 Mbps (Honor→P30 110.8 Mbps). Relink 8 s after the Honor app restarted. After 20 min asleep and unplugged (simulated) both apps were alive (no OEM kill) and a talk reached the still-sleeping Honor in 14 s. Battery 152 mAh in 20 min (Wi-Fi radio 125) = 10.9 %/h — caused by an incoming-talk envelope write loop (>1 write/s, ~16 KB/s of Gun traffic), not by the LAN link; fixed in 1.0.108 (0 writes, 0 bytes in 15 s). Versions checked before and after.

runs.deviceModel: Essential PH-1 owner ↔ C10 tablet client
runs.lifecycleState: both screens off 20 min (Dozing; deviceidle deep INACTIVE)
runs.notes: Group survived 20 min on both (groupFormed true, apps alive, no kill). PH-1 (Android 10) still ran JS while asleep and broadcast a talk, but the Android 14 tablet froze its WebView page while dozing (no console output at all) and did not receive until the app is opened again. Waking the screen behind the lock screen did not resume it.

runs.direction: Huawei P30 Pro to backgrounded C10 tablet
runs.lifecycleState: receiver sent to HOME, then explicitly foregrounded
runs.notes: Targeted functional assertion passed, but this is not a complete route-qualification run: throughput, battery drain and reconnect time were not measured. All four fresh app sandboxes independently derived nearby_v1_e1_p1000_g0_7687df4a5167333068f71903 from the same 10 m-accuracy test location; no coordinates appeared in the shared active scope and the server roster converged to four. The directed Talk reached the Android 14 receiver after foreground resume and the author's encrypted direct outbox cleared only after the end-recipient ACK. This validates the new native onResume signal and bounded WebRTC transport refresh. It does not claim BLE, Wi-Fi Direct, Internet-path, or statistically meaningful battery coverage. Playwright native-app/30 background-only: 1/1 passed in 2.7 min.

runs.direction: three-phone ring plus Huawei P30 Pro to post-background C10 tablet
runs.lifecycleState: foreground ring; Android 14 receiver sent to HOME and explicitly foregrounded
runs.notes: Targeted functional assertion passed, but this is not a complete route-qualification run: throughput, battery drain and reconnect time were not measured. All three fresh sandboxes independently derived the same opaque Nearby room and converged on its three-person roster without the hub. Native state proved one owner with two clients, 192.168.49.x group links, and zero LAN peers. Ring delivery times were 18314, 10216, and 10506 ms; the Android 14 post-background delivery was 9587 ms and cleared the author's encrypted outbox only after its ACK. BLE presence was enabled and scoped peer records were observed, but this run did not isolate BLE from Wi-Fi Direct DNS-SD/peer-scan fallback. Short battery snapshots are not a drain measurement. Playwright native-app/30 offline mode: 1/1 passed in 2.5 min.

runs.notes: Targeted OPEN-38 functional assertion passed, but this is not a complete route-qualification run: throughput, battery drain and reconnect time were not measured. The sender queued one Talk after the receiver heartbeat had lapsed. MailboxWatcher posted the generic new-activity notification 22 s later while the P30 remained asleep; after wake, the direct scheduler delivered the Talk and it appeared in IN. runs.lifecycleState: receiver screen off for 5 min; ordinary idle, not forced Doze
runs.notes: The sender queued one Talk, but no notification appeared during the four-minute assertion window. POST_NOTIFICATIONS was granted. Android logcat shows system_server force-stopping com.iinpublic.app about 90 s after screen-off, killing the foreground service, embedded node, alarm receiver and long-poll together. An in-process wake path cannot survive this OEM policy.
